<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

## Zero-SM KV-Shard Gather

The sharded pool's per-layer prefix allgather previously used NCCL ring/LL kernels. When overlapped with attention and GEMMs, these kernels competed for SMs and HBM bandwidth.

`SGLANG_ENABLE_KV_SHARD_ZERO_SM_GATHER` enables **zero-SM** gathering and is on by default. The gather communicator is created with `NCCL_CTA_POLICY_ZERO`, allowing NCCL to run the in-place allgather on copy engines instead of SM kernels.

### Memory Allocation

Both scratch slots are carved from a single `ncclMemAlloc` buffer registered as a symmetric window. Each slot uses a 4 KiB-aligned offset that is identical across all ranks.

- `_scratch_tensor_specs` returns a mapping of `name -> (shape, dtype)`.
- The mixin handles allocation.
- The buffer is deregistered and freed when its last tensor view is destroyed.

### Activation and Fallbacks

The engine defaults `NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE=1` when zero-SM gathering applies to a single-node deployment.

The pool retains Torch allocation when any of the following applies:

- `SGLANG_ENABLE_KV_SHARD_ZERO_SM_GATHER` is disabled.
- A memory saver or custom memory pool is active.
- The NCCL version is older than 2.28.
- The shard group spans multiple nodes. NCCL would use its hierarchical inter-node RMA path in this case, which remains unverified.

If window registration returns a `NULL` window because NCCL cuMem is disabled, the pool logs one warning and gathering remains on SM kernels.

### NCCL 2.30 Race Workaround

With NVLS enabled, NCCL 2.30 lazily builds the multicast team during the first copy-engine collective's synchronization, without a barrier. This race can cause the first gather to hang.

The pool works around the race by building the multicast team during registration and issuing a barrier afterward.

### GPU Test Coverage

The GPU test profiles a batch of gathers and verifies that:

- No NCCL kernels are launched.
- Peer copies occur.

A gather communicator that loses `NCCL_CTA_POLICY_ZERO` therefore fails the test.

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.srt.distributed.device_communicators.pynccl import PyNcclCommunicator
+    from sglang.srt.distributed.device_communicators.pynccl_wrapper import ncclWindow_t
+
 after_2_8_0 = torch_release >= (2, 8)
 
+
+class _NcclMemOwner:
+    """Exposes one ncclMemAlloc buffer to torch, which keeps this object alive
+    as long as any view of the wrapping tensor exists."""
+
+    def __init__(self, ptr: int, nbytes: int):
+        self.__cuda_array_interface__ = {
+            "shape": (nbytes,),
+            "typestr": "|u1",
+            "data": (ptr, False),
+            "version": 3,
+        }
+
+
+def _release_nccl_window_buffer(
+    comm: PyNcclCommunicator, ptr: int, window: Optional[ncclWindow_t]
+) -> None:
+    # Queued communication or computation may still be touching the buffer.
+    torch.cuda.synchronize(comm.device)
+    if window is not None:
+        comm.deregister_comm_window(window)
+    comm.nccl.ncclMemFree(ptr)
+
+
+def allocate_symmetric_buffer(
+    comm: PyNcclCommunicator, nbytes: int
+) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, bool]:
+    """Zeroed uint8 tensor over ncclMemAlloc memory registered as a symmetric
+    window on ``comm`` (a collective call), and whether NCCL returned a window.
+
+    Every rank must request the same size and use matching offsets for views.
+    This allocation is independent of the shared symmetric memory pool and
+    --enable-symm-mem. It is deregistered and freed when the last view dies.
+    The returned flag means a symmetric window only on NCCL >= 2.29.2.
+    """
+    with torch.cuda.device(comm.device):
+        ptr = comm.nccl.ncclMemAlloc(nbytes)
+        window = comm.register_comm_window_raw(ptr, nbytes)
+        # NCCL >= 2.29.2 returns NULL when the comm has no symmetric memory
+        # support, usually because NCCL runs without cuMem (ncclMemAlloc is
+        # then a cudaMalloc); 2.28.x returns a local-registration handle.
+        window = window if window.value else None
+        if window is not None and comm.nccl.has_function(
+            "ncclGetLsaMultimemDevicePointer"
+        ):
+            # Workaround for NCCL 2.29.7+ with NVLS on a 2-rank comm (fixed
+            # upstream by NCCL commit 430afbc, after 2.30.7): the multicast
+            # team is built lazily inside the first CE collective's sync
+            # (ncclDevrGetLsaTeamPtrMC) with no barrier after binding, so a
+            # fast rank's ready flag can miss a peer and both hang. Build the
+            # team now (the multicast address is not needed) and barrier.
+            # Larger comms, and older NCCL without this API, build the team
+            # during window registration behind a barrier already.
+            comm.nccl.ncclGetLsaMultimemDevicePointer(window, 0)
+            torch.distributed.barrier(group=comm.group)
+        owner = _NcclMemOwner(ptr, nbytes)
+        release = weakref.finalize(
+            owner, _release_nccl_window_buffer, comm, ptr, window
+        )
+        # The process teardown reclaims the memory; NCCL may already be gone.
+        release.atexit = False
+        buf = torch.as_tensor(owner)
+    buf.zero_()
+    return buf, window is not None
+

+        lambda pg, source_rank: [r == source_rank for r in range(world)],
+    ):
+        pool, req_to_token, prefix_len, seq_len = _run_mla(rank, world, port)
+    assert not pool._use_symmetric_scratch and not pool._scratch_window_registered
+    activity = _gather_gpu_activity(pool, req_to_token, prefix_len, seq_len)
+    assert any("nccl" in name.lower() for name in activity)
+
+
+@unittest.skipIf(
+    torch.cuda.device_count() < 2, "page-interleave gather needs 2 CUDA devices"
+)
+class TestPageInterleaveZeroSmGatherMultiGpu(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_copy_engine_window_gather_and_release(self):
+        """The zero-SM pool registers its scratch as a symmetric window, still
+        assembles the canonical prefix, and frees the window buffer only once
+        the pool and every scratch view are gone."""
+        # The library the pool gates on, which may differ from torch's NCCL.
+        if NCCLLibrary().ncclGetRawVersion() < 22902:
+            self.skipTest("the symmetric gather scratch needs NCCL >= 2.29.2")
+        # Clear the global override before spawning: only the dedicated
+        # gather communicator requests ZERO. cuMem enables window registration.
+        with (
+            temp_set_env(NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE="1", NCCL_CTA_POLICY=None),
+            envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_KV_SHARD_ZERO_SM_GATHER.override(True),
+        ):
+            mp.spawn(
+                _run_zero_sm_mla,
+                args=(_GATHER_WORLD, 29811),
+                nprocs=_GATHER_WORLD,
+                join=True,
+            )
+
+    def test_cross_node_group_keeps_sm_gather(self):
+        """A shard group spanning nodes keeps the torch scratch and the SM
+        allgather, even with cuMem on."""
+        with (
+            temp_set_env(NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE="1", NCCL_CTA_POLICY=None),
+            envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_KV_SHARD_ZERO_SM_GATHER.override(True),
+        ):
+            mp.spawn(
+                _run_cross_node_mla,
+                args=(_GATHER_WORLD, 29811),
+                nprocs=_GATHER_WORLD,
+                join=True,
+            )
+
+

 # Indexer: packed FP8 keys and FP32 scales over real NCCL (2 and 4 GPUs).
 # =============================================================================
